SESSION_SECRET.description: HS256 signing secret for session tokens. Auto-generated per deploy.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Canonical public origin. Used for NIP-98 URL binding and the login UI. Resolves on second deploy.

PAID_VERIFY.description: Set to 'on' (plus your wallet + CDP keys below) to enable the $0.001-per-verify x402 oracle. Off = free gate mode.

X402_PAY_TO.description: Wallet address that receives x402 payments ($0.001 per verification). Replace with your own address.

X402_PRICE_USD.description: Price per signature verification through POST /v1/verify.

X402_CDP_KEY_ID.description: Coinbase CDP API key ID — required only when PAID_VERIFY=on. Leave empty for gate-only mode. Never use placeholder values.

X402_CDP_KEY_SECRET.description: Coinbase CDP API key secret (PEM EC or base64 Ed25519) — required only when PAID_VERIFY=on. Leave empty for gate-only mode.

GATE_COOKIE_NAME.description: Cookie name checked by the forward-auth /gate endpoint.
